string.name: security_regen_message
string.value: Regenerating will overwrite the key currently entered. Data that is already encrypted can only be decrypted with the old key.

string.name: security_keystore_failed_title
string.value: Encryption key not saved to system secure storage

string.name: security_keystore_failed_message
string.value:
SourceTime could not store the encryption key in the system asset vault.

If you don't retry, the app will not unlock automatically on the next launch and you will have to enter the key manually.

string.name: security_secret_required
string.value: Enter or generate an encryption key

string.name: security_secret_length_invalid
string.value: The key must be 12-128 characters long

string.name: security_no_local_data
string.value: No encrypted data on this device yet; you can set a new key directly

string.name: security_forget_message
string.value:
Once confirmed, the old key will be deleted from system secure storage, and the encrypted data files (TOTP entries and history backups) plus the WebDAV password will be permanently deleted from this device.

SourceTime cannot recover keys, so the data cannot be retrieved after deletion. You will need to set a new key and add your codes again from scratch.

string.name: security_delete_old_key_failed_title
string.value: Failed to delete the old key

string.name: security_delete_old_key_failed_message
string.value: The encryption key could not be deleted from system secure storage. To avoid leaving the old key behind, local encrypted data has not been cleared. Please try again.

string.name: security_cleared
string.value: Old key and encrypted data cleared; please set a new key

string.name: security_key_lost_body
string.value: The encryption key in system secure storage has been lost. Previously encrypted data (including TOTP entries and the WebDAV password) can no longer be decrypted. Set a new key; you will need to re-enter the WebDAV password afterwards.

string.name: security_local_protection_body
string.value: SourceTime protects your local TOTP data with the encryption key you set. The key is never uploaded to any server.

string.name: security_verify_current_body
string.value: Changing the encryption key requires verifying the current key first. Once verified, all data will be re-encrypted with the new key.

string.name: security_set_new_body
string.value: Old key verified. Enter or randomly generate a new encryption key.

string.name: security_keep_safe_body
string.value: SourceTime offers no server-side key recovery. If the key is lost, encrypted data can no longer be decrypted.

string.name: security_app_lock_on_body
string.value: On cold start and when returning to the foreground, the code list is covered until you enter your 6-digit PIN. The PIN is only verified locally with PBKDF2 and is never sent in any network request.

string.name: security_app_lock_off_body
string.value: When enabled, the code list is covered on cold start and when returning to the foreground until you enter your 6-digit PIN. SourceTime does not store the PIN; if you forget it, the only option is to clear the app data.

string.name: pin_mismatch
string.value: The two PINs do not match

string.name: pin_new_mismatch
string.value: The two new PINs do not match

string.name: pin_current_required_before_disable
string.value: Enter your current PIN before turning off the app lock

string.name: pin_locked_hint
string.value: Enter your app lock PIN to view your codes

string.name: pin_locked_retry
string.value: Too many attempts. Try again in %d seconds

string.name: pin_forgot_hint
string.value: If you forget the PIN, you must clear the app data; codes and the encryption key will be unrecoverable
